notes.title: Operation: Night Strikers Day, Aug 15th in Akihabara!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]All units: converge on Akihabara![/b][/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41309941/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png[/img]
On August 15, we’re holding a special Night Striker-focused event above the Hey arcade in Akihabara, Tokyo. The venue will feature merchandise sales—including limited and early-release items—an actual arcade Night Striker cabinet on display, and a hands-on play area.

In the morning, we’ll host the “Night Striker Special Tactical Action Force Skills Trial in Hey” competition. Players will take on designated stages, competing for the highest Running Point score (displayed on the game’s gadget) at stage end. Entry is limited to 20 participants; if applications exceed this number, players will be selected at random. Those wishing to participate should register at the Hey 2F counter between 10:00 and 10:15 on the day of the event.

At 15:00, we present the “Monthly ZUNTATA NIGHT – Special Summer 2025 Edition in Hey”. Guests will include M2 development staff from Operation Night Strikers and Night Striker GEAR, showcasing live gameplay and delivering talks from the sound creators. The session will also be streamed live on YouTube—so if you can’t attend in person, join us online!
[p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8"]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8[/url]([i]Stream available in Japanese only.[/i])[/p]

notes.title: Darius Debut Day: October 7th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41487515/69c7468a814a718b4b42a4ae1990001b6279e296.png[/img]

To celebrate Darius Debut Day on 7 October, we’re having a sale on series titles [b]until 23:59 (Japan time) on Tuesday 8 October 2024[/b].
Celebrate with us by experiencing the Darius series’ titles!




[h3]What is Darius Debut Day?[/h3]
The original Darius was first unveiled at the Amusement Show in Japan, on 7th October 1986, and was subsequently launched in game arcades in February 1987. Thus, 7th October, when the title was first announced, is now designated as Darius Debut Day.

notes.title: New update and leaderboard reset
notes.notes:
We've successfully updated the game, fixing the leaderboard issue, and in line with this, the leaderboards and replay data have been reset too.
Thanks for your understanding and apologies for the inconvenience, but we hope you al continue to enjoy beam-battling giant space-faring fish in G-Darius HD!

notes.title: Incoming update and leaderboard reset
notes.notes:
A bug has been discovered in the leaderboards for the game, which prevents scores of around 33 million or more from registering correctly.
In order to correct this issue, we will be testing a fix on the the following date:
Monday, 8 April 2024, 23:00-27:00 (PDT)
Tuesday, 9 April 2024, 15:00-18:00 (JST)
During this time, G-Darius HD may be played as usual, but the leaderboards and replay data will be reset when the update is released.
Please accept our apologies and thank you for your continued support of G-Darius HD.

notes.title: Steam Deck update now live!
notes.notes: Happy New Year and a huge thanks to everyone who tested the beta branch release ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1640160/announcements/detail/3884981746125989261?snr=2___]see here[/url]), the updates are now live in the main branch.

notes.title: You will see the creation of new lives, on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
We noticed a recent OS update meant the game stopped working properly on Steam Deck, and now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478020/Rayz_Arcade_Chronology/]Ray’z Arcade Chronology[/url] is working again, we're launching a fix for G-Darius HD via a beta branch until January 8th.
There's also a test running for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638330/Darius_Cozmic_Collection_Arcade]Darius Cozmic Collection[/url] too!
If you have a Steam Deck and would like to participate, the details are below.
Right-click on Darius Cozmic Collection from the library page and select "Properties", then select the "BETAS" tab, and enter the password "TRIPODSARDINE".
 
All G-Darius games included should now work, so you can witness the creation of new lives on the go!
However, if you encounter any issues which mangle your α Beam, or prevent your capture ball fun, please let us know here!
